# sigma_template (Data Source)

Look up a single workbook template by ID via `GET /v2/templates/{templateId}`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `template_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `latest_version` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `path` (String)
- `template_url_id` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `updated_by` (String)
